mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its historical average signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 330 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 3.5%, the market perceives inadequate monetary policy response to high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 330 and FEDFUNDS < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (relative to 2017 baseline) signals a supply shock that disrupts corporate supply chains and reduces earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to its historical average signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% signals strong consumer spending that typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in near-term economic strength.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceed 158,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, the labor market is perceived as robust, boosting consumer confidence and corporate hiring, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 158000 and UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a high GDP expansion regime (GDPC1 > 24000), the S&P 500 is prone to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in potential overvaluation and the end of the economic cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 24000.
